question:
I am trying pip install --upgrade dbt-core dbt-postgres dbt-snowflake to upgrade to dbt 1.10. However, this only upgrades to version 1.9.4.

How can I upgrade to 1.10?
title: Unable to upgrade dbt version to 1.10
answer:
since the 1.10 versions are on pre-release maybe you can try --pre flag to install them
pip install --upgrade --pre dbt-core dbt-postgres dbt-snowflake
